en.askTitle: Swap in your own cities, dates, family and shipping plan, and get the same dated move plan
en.runTitle: Family of three, Singapore to Sydney on 1 July 2027: budget, checklist and sources

fields.label: Available cash and income gap
fields.placeholder: e.g. S$60,000 saved and a 2-month gap between salaries

fields.label: Job and lease notice terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. 2 months’ notice at work, lease ending 30 June 2027

fields.label: School needs and real address
fields.value: NSW public school enrolment for the 6-year-old

fields.label: Inventory and shipping preferences
fields.value: Contents of a 3-bedroom condo; compare a 20ft container, shared container and air freight for essentials

fields.label: Car plans
fields.placeholder: e.g. buy a used car in Sydney rather than ship ours

en.template: Plan our move from {departure} to {arrival} on {date} for {family}, with {citizenship}, {cash}, {notice}, {school}, {inventory} and {car}. Separate spending, refundable deposits and buffers; resolve school and tenancy timing before setting a final budget. Only plan: do not contact, apply, book or pay.

phases.title: Research current moving costs and the official relocation rules
phases.note: Australian import and school rules, Singapore exit steps, and published shipping prices

phases.title: Build an editable budget, a dated checklist and a source list
phases.note: Spreadsheet scenarios, a checklist working back from 1 July, and sources with access dates
phases.judgment: It would not turn rough figures into quotes: the air-freight range is a general guide, not a Sydney price; S$1,776 for three flight seats is labelled illustrative arithmetic; and a garbled price table was not reinterpreted as a shipment total.

phases.title: Recalculate the spreadsheet, check the pages visually and hand over the files
phases.judgment: It caught a timing clash in the plan itself: school starts on 20 July 2027, before the default permanent tenancy on 29 July, and the plan flags how to resolve it. All 63 spreadsheet formulas recalculated with zero errors.

workers: Read the official Australian rules on importing household goods, NSW school enrolment, Medicare re-enrolment, driving licences and car registration
Checked the Singapore side of leaving: employer tax clearance, pass cancellation, CPF and insurance
Collected published prices for sea and air freight, July flights and four weeks of temporary housing in Sydney

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的城市、日期、家庭和运输打算，得到同样带日期的搬家计划
zh.runTitle: 三口之家，2027 年 7 月 1 日从新加坡搬到悉尼：预算、清单和来源

fields.label: 抵达日期
fields.value: 主要搬家日为 2027 年 7 月 1 日

fields.label: 家庭成员和年龄
fields.value: 两位成人、一个 6 岁孩子

fields.label: 可用资金和收入空档
fields.placeholder: 例如：存款 6 万新元，两份工资之间空档 2 个月

fields.label: 雇佣及租约通知条款
fields.placeholder: 例如：工作需提前 2 个月通知，租约 2027 年 6 月 30 日到期

fields.label: 入学需要和真实地址
fields.value: 6 岁孩子要入读新州公立小学

fields.label: 物品清单及运输偏好
fields.value: 三居室公寓里的全部物品；比较 20 尺整柜、拼箱，以及急用物品走空运

fields.label: 购车打算
fields.placeholder: 例如：到悉尼买二手车，不运现在这辆

zh.template: 请按{departure}、{date}、{family}、{citizenship}、{cash}、{notice}、{school}、{inventory}、{car}，规划全家搬迁。分清花费、可退押金和缓冲，先接好入学与租期，再定最终预算。只做计划，不联系、不申请、不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 查当前搬家费用和官方搬迁规定
phases.note: 澳洲进口与入学规定、新加坡离境步骤、已公布的运费

phases.title: 做出可编辑的预算表、带日期的清单和来源列表
phases.note: 表格里有多种情景，清单从 7 月 1 日倒推，来源附查阅日期
phases.judgment: 粗略数字它不会当报价用：空运区间只是通用参考，不是悉尼的价格；三个机位的 1,776 新元标明只是示意算术；一张乱码的价目表也没有硬解读成整批货的总价。

phases.title: 重算表格、检查页面外观并交付文件
phases.judgment: 它发现了计划本身的时间冲突：孩子 2027 年 7 月 20 日开学，早于默认的长租起租日 7 月 29 日，计划里标出了解决办法。表格里 63 个公式全部重算，零错误。

workers: 读澳洲官方关于家庭物品入境、新州入学、医保重新登记、驾照和车辆登记的规定
核对新加坡这一侧的离境事项：雇主税务结清、准证注销、公积金和保险
收集已公布的海运和空运价格、7 月机票，以及悉尼 4 周临时住宿价格
